_ainet.role: Hot index only. Short digest for this COP so AIs can orient fast; deep detail lives in sibling leaves. OAC deep-dives via tools when needed.
belongs: small priority lists: important_context, active_items, recent_changes, known_facts, uncertainties
path pointers to deeper files (e.g. Identity/Core.json) — never inline long bodies
needs_update + read_changelog (freshness metadata for SOI Phase 2)
_ainet.edit: known_facts and uncertainties use fact_shape objects, not bare strings. Prefer path pointers over long fact text.
_ainet.freshness: needs_update + read_changelog gate SOI Phase 2. Writers auto-call mark_read_stale; refresh only when needs_update or pending changelog entries exist. After rewrite, mark_read_refreshed clears the gate.
